programme.title: Sports Scene
programme.desc: Sports Scene brings you closer to all the action from all corners of the world, with highlights from across Europe, North America and China's top sports leagues.

programme.title: O Estrangeiro
programme.desc: Quando a sua filha adolescente é morta por uma bomba num atentado terrorista cometido pelo IRA, Quan, que fora treinado pelas forças especiais os EUA, não se vai deter perante nada para encontrar os culpados pelo atentado, por via de Liam Hennessy, atual deputado e antigo membro da organização.

programme.title: Underworld - O Submundo
programme.desc: Numa guerra que dura há séculos, os vampiros e lobisomens lutam pela supremacia do Submundo longe do olhar dos humanos. Mas agora os lobisomens planeiam raptar um jovem médico humano para criar uma nova e invencível espécie. Apenas Selene, uma guerreira vampira, pode impedir este plano.

programme.title: O Uivo
programme.desc: Numa noite de tempestade, o último comboio de Londres trava de emergência numa floresta. O maquinista sai para investigar e desaparece, os passageiros ficam em pânico ao ouvirem uivos vindos da escuridão e há uma criatura à solta que obriga a que todos se juntem para sobreviver.

programme.title: A Mulher
programme.desc: Joan Castleman é uma mulher inteligente que durante anos foi a esposa perfeita, sacrificando o próprio talento para ajudar a carreira de escritor do marido. Mas quando este é laureado com o Nobel da Literatura, a viagem a Estocolmo vai fazê-la questionar todos os segredos da sua vida... e da dele.

programme.title: Um Mercado De Milhões
programme.desc: O futebol dos nossos dias é uma indústria global onde estão em jogo milhares de milhões de euros. Driss Berzane é um agente de jogadores à beira da falência, que tem apenas sete dias até ao encerramento do mercado de transferências para conseguir pagar uma dívida de 300 mil euros.

programme.title: Yesterday
programme.desc: Um músico que luta pela sobrevivência, dá-se conta subitamente de que é a única pessoa em todo o planeta que se lembra dos Beatles e da sua música. Depois dessa descoberta a sua vida nunca mais será a mesma.

programme.title: O Filho
programme.desc: A vida atribulada de Peter, da sua nova companheira Beth e do bebé do casal vai tornar-se ainda mais complicada quando vai viver lá para casa o problemático filho de 17 anos que ele teve com a ex-mulher, para o qual gostaria de ser o pai atento e cuidador que ele próprio nunca teve.

programme.title: Sem Hora Marcada
programme.desc: Uma jovem a tirar fotografias na natureza testemunha sem querer o assassínio de um traficante por uma polícia e vê-se envolvida numa conspiração que envolve agentes corruptos. Em fuga pela vida, a única pessoa que lhe pode valer é um velho oficial reformado.

programme.title: Yakuza
programme.desc: Harry Kilmer é um detetive norte-americano reformado que regressa ao Japão após décadas de ausência para tentar salvar a filha de um amigo, raptada pela organização criminosa nipónica cujos membros são conhecidos como Yakuza.

programme.title: Mercenário: A Redenção
programme.desc: Quando um assassino profissional conhece uma rapariga que foge de um poderoso chefe da máfia politicamente influente, ele vai sentir-se dividido entre proteger a jovem ou permanecer fiel à agência governamental que o contratou.

programme.title: Simulação
programme.desc: Num futuro próximo, um humanoide procura um hacker de habilidades excecionais para que este lhe remova todas as restrições que afetam os seus pensamentos e capacidades. Essa ação desencadeia uma revolta entre as unidades de inteligência artificial e leva o governo a tomar medidas drásticas.

programme.title: Cidade Dividida
programme.desc: Na cidade de Nova Iorque, Billy Taggart, um ex-polícia caído em desgraça trabalha como investigador particular e é contratado pelo presidente da câmara de Nova Iorque, a quem deve um enorme favor, para espiar a sua mulher.

programme.title: Os Pássaros
programme.desc: Melanie Daniels é uma socialite que persegue Mitch Brenner até uma cidade costeira da Califórnia, onde, pouco depois, aves de toda a espécie começam a atacar os habitantes sem razão aparente, em vagas cada vez mais violentas e aterrorizantes.

programme.title: Instinto Predador
programme.desc: Um navio grego transporta animais exóticos perigosos da Amazónia, incluindo um raro jaguar branco. Nessa mesma embarcação, um assassino, que estava a ser extraditado em segredo para os EUA, consegue fugir e libertar todos os animais em cativeiro, deixando os tripulantes em perigo de vida.

programme.title: Meia-Noite Em Switchgrass
programme.desc: Dois agentes do FBI a investigar uma rede de tráfico sexual cruzam-se com uma série de casos de homicídios de mulheres na Florida. Quando uma missão infiltrada dá para o torto e a própria agente é raptada, um oficial daquele estado tem poucas horas para a libertar e apanhar o brutal criminoso.

programme.title: Her Smell - A Música Nas Veias
programme.desc: Uma cantora de punk rock auto-destrutiva luta por se manter sóbria, enquanto tenta recuperar a inspiração e a criatividade que catapultou a sua banda para o sucesso.

programme.title: O Bravo
programme.desc: Um índio americano na mó de baixo que acaba de sair da prisão recebe a proposta de protagonizar um filme em que é filmada a sua própria morte a troco de uma larga soma em dinheiro que poderá retirar a sua família da pobreza extrema.

programme.title: Negócios De Ocasião
programme.desc: O proprietário de uma pequena empresa e os seus dois sócios viajam para a Europa para fecharem o negócio mais importante das suas vidas. Mas o que começou como uma viagem de negócios vai sair fora dos carris, incluindo escalas não programadas…

programme.title: Os Três Mosqueteiros
programme.desc: Ao lado de um jovem recruta ansioso por proteger o Rei de França, três leais espadachins tentam derrotar o pérfido conselheiro real e a sedutora espia enviada para derrubar a coroa.

programme.title: A Modista
programme.desc: Quando Tilly regressa a casa, numa pequena cidade rural australiana, vai reconciliar-se com a mãe doente e vai recorrer à sua experiência na alta costura para transformar as mulheres locais e vingar-se de quem antes lhe tinha feito mal.

programme.title: Call Jane Tu Não Estás Só
programme.desc: Na Chicago dos anos 60, uma mulher casada e feliz vê sua vida virada do avesso quando tem uma gravidez que coloca um sério risco à sua própria vida. Sem hipótese de a interromper de forma legal, ela acaba por entrar em contacto com um grupo de mulheres que lhe oferece ajuda, as “Jane”.

programme.title: Os Pássaros
programme.desc: Melanie Daniels é uma socialite que persegue Mitch Brenner até uma cidade costeira da Califórnia, onde, pouco depois, aves de toda a espécie começam a atacar os habitantes sem razão aparente, em vagas cada vez mais violentas e aterrorizantes.

programme.title: Os Estagiários
programme.desc: Billy e Nick são vendedores cujas carreiras foram destruídas pela era digital. Na tentativa de provar que não estão obsoletos, conseguem um cobiçado estágio na Google, juntamente com um batalhão de pequenos génios. O problema é que eles são quase info-excluídos…

programme.title: Big Game Instinto Caçador
programme.desc: Nas florestas da Finlândia, um jovem de 13 anos descobre uma cápsula de salvação do Air Force One. O homem ferido à sua frente é o Presidente dos EUA, e há um grupo de terroristas a caminho para tentar raptá-lo. Agora vão ter de agir em equipa para sobreviver à noite mais perigosa das suas vidas.

programme.title: Gone - 12 Horas Para Viver
programme.desc: Jill Parrish está convencida que Molly, a sua irmã desaparecida, foi sequestrada pelo mesmo assassino em série de quem escapou no ano anterior. Mas será que Jill se encontra psicologicamente perturbada ou é a única que conhece a verdade, conseguindo encontrar Molly antes que seja tarde demais?

programme.title: Assim Nasce Uma Estrela
programme.desc: Ester Blodgett é uma jovem cantora que ascende ao estrelato em Hollywood graças ao apoio de Norman Maine, um ator famoso por quem ela se apaixona, que por sua vez se está a afundar no alcoolismo e no esquecimento.

programme.title: Força Em Alerta 2
programme.desc: Casey Ryback parte de férias com a sobrinha num comboio do Colorado a Los Angeles, só que, logo no início da viagem, um grupo de terroristas invade o veiculo para usá-lo como quartel general na captura de um satélite altamente secreto e extraordinariamente destrutivo.

programme.title: Peppermint
programme.desc: Riley North acorda de um coma após o assassinato do seu marido e da sua filha num brutal ataque à sua família. Quando o sistema protege os assassinos da justiça, Riley transforma-se numa verdadeira guerrilheira urbana, aplicando de forma metódica a sua forma muito pessoal de justiça.

programme.title: Relação Perigosa
programme.desc: Num colégio feminino na Austrália, uma aluna apaixonada pelo professor de filosofia acusa-o falsamente de violação quando se sente rejeitada por ele.

programme.title: Puccini - Madama Butterfly
programme.desc: Italian conductor Beatrice Venezi leads the Orchestre national de Metz Grand Est and the Choeur de l'Opéra-Théâtre de Metz Métropole in a performance of Giacomo Puccini’s tragic opera Madama Butterfly (1904). The story revolves around Cio-Cio-San, the young Japanese geisha ‘Butterfly’ who marries the visiting American officer Pinkerton. Faithfully awaiting his return, she cannot accept that Pinkerton has abandoned her.

programme.title: The Berlin Philharmonic in Tokyo
programme.desc: The Berliner Philharmoniker is one of the world’s finest orchestras, its fame stretching all the way to Japan. Unsurprisingly, this 2000 concert, recorded at Tokyo’s magnificent Suntory Hall, was a resounding success. Mariss Jansons conducts a beautiful program that includes Antonin Dvorák’s Symphony No. 8, Carl Maria von Weber’s Overture to Oberon, and Dmitri Shostakovich’s Violin Concerto featuring star violinist Hilary Hahn (*1979).

programme.title: England, my England - I
programme.desc: From August 28 to September 6, 2015, the Early Music Festival Utrecht focused on England, my England. On the basis of the festival theme, presenter Lex Bohlmeijer takes the viewer in a two-part documentary on an intriguing journey through England of the Middle Ages, Renaissance and Baroque, and relates this to the city of Utrecht.

programme.title: Beethoven - Violin Concerto, Op. 61
programme.desc: Bernard Haitink conducts the Berliner Philharmoniker at the Easter Festival in Baden-Baden, 2015. On the program is Ludwig van Beethoven's Violin Concerto, Op. 61. The award-winning Isabelle Faust is the soloist, and since her recordings with Claudio Abbado, she’s the first choice when it comes to this masterpiece.

programme.title: Rachmaninoff - Piano Concerto No. 4, Op. 40
programme.desc: Fabio Luisi conducts the Danish National Symphony Orchestra in this powerful performance taken from the 150th Anniversary celebrations of Denmark’s national composer, Carl Nielsen. Alongside Nielsen’s inscrutably ironic Symphony No. 6, this performance features world-renowned French pianist Lise de la Salle as soloist in Rachmaninov’s Piano Concerto No. 4.

programme.title: Classica Spotlight
programme.desc: Cinematic classical clips and energizing concert pieces featuring up-and-coming artists.

programme.title: At Home with Bach
programme.desc: Klaus Mertens (baritone) and Ton Koopman (organ, harpsichord) join forces in their program 'At Home with Bach'. The duo creates an atmosphere of conviviality and present multiple works by Bach from the Gohliser Schlösschen in Leipzig.

programme.title: Glass - Double Concerto for Two Pianos
programme.desc: As part of a new collaboration with the famous composer of 'music with repetitive structures' Philip Glass, French pianists Katia and Marielle Labèque perform the European premiere of Glass's Concerto for two pianos with the Orchester de Paris conducted by Jaap van Zweden, current music director of the New York Philharmonic.

programme.title: Lucerne Festival - Abbado conducts Mahler No. 1
programme.desc: Claudio Abbado conducts the Lucerne Festival Orchestra in Gustav Mahler’s Symphony No. 1. The principal motif of this symphony, “Like a cry of Nature”, gave the Lucerne Festival 2009 its central theme. To Mahler, nature and art are not opposed but are rather symbiotic, with one informing the other.

programme.title: Tchaikovsky - Lensky’s aria from Eugene Onegin
programme.desc: At the behest of Argentinian pianist Martha Argerich, several classical music stars took part in this concert in aid of the Erasmus Fund for medical research in intensive care, recorded at the Royal Conservatory of Brussels, Belgium, on October 21, 2023. The concert pays tribute to the renowned cellist Aleksandr Khramouchin (1979) who suddenly passed away on May 13, 2023.

programme.title: Discovering Masterpieces – Symphonie Fantastique
programme.desc: Watch the series ‘Discovering Masterpieces’, your audio-visual concert guide to the great masterpieces of classical music. The series brings you 20 half-hour documentaries on 20 classical masterpieces: acclaimed experts, famous soloists and outstanding conductors take you on a journey back to the time and place of composition. In today’s documentary, Hector Berlioz’ ‘Symphonie Fantastique’.

programme.title: Schubert - Four Impromptus, Op. 90: - I.
programme.desc: Roberto Prosseda (1975) performs Mozart's Piano Sonata No. 5 (KV. 283) and four Impromptus Op. 90 by Franz Schubert. The performance ends with Chopin's technically demanding Ballade No. 4, Op. 52. Prosseda is particularly noted for his performances of newly discovered works by Mendelssohn and has recorded a nine-CD series for Decca of the piano works of Mendelssohn.

programme.title: Classica Spotlight
programme.desc: Cinematic classical clips and energizing concert pieces featuring up-and-coming artists.

programme.title: Memory of a Concert
programme.desc: In 2006, Gidon Kremer and Martha Argerich set out on tour performing solos and duets by Bartók und Schumann. The last of the concert series at the Berliner Philharmonie has been recorded for this film, featuring a rare solo performance by Martha Argerich. A concert film with personal and moving commentary by Gidon Kremer. Program: Schumann's Violin Sonata No. 1, Op. 10, Violin Sonata No. 2, Op. 121; Kinderszenen, Op.

programme.title: Brahms - Violin Sonata No. 1, Op. 78
programme.desc: In this splendid 2013 concert from the Church of Verbier, Switzerland, Greek violinist Leonidas Kavakos and Chinese pianist Yuja Wang join forces to interpret three sonatas by Johannes Brahms. Leonidas Kavakos rose to fame in 1985, when he became the youngest musician to ever win the first price of the prestigious Sibelius Competition.

programme.title: Schumann - Symphony No. 1 in B-flat major
programme.desc: German conductor Christian Zacharias leads the Orchestre national de Lille in a performance of Robert Schumann’s Symphony No. 1 in B-flat major, Op. 38, also known as the ‘Spring Symphony’. This optimistic work is written in 1841 and is the most performed of Schumann’s four symphonies. This concert was recorded at Auditorium du Nouveau Siècle in Lille, France, on June 16, 2017.

programme.title: Works for cello and piano: Debussy, Gershwin a.o.
programme.desc: Italian cellist Silvia Chiesa and Italian pianist Maurizio Baglini perform a wonderful recital as part of the 2023 edition of the Amiata Piano Festival. On the program are Claude Debussy’s Cello Sonata, L. 135; Allegro moderato from Camille Saint-Saëns’s Cello Sonata No. 1 in C minor, Op. 32; Allegro ma non troppo from Johannes Brahms’s Cello Sonata No. 1 in E minor, Op.

programme.title: PIAM - Semi-final II: Chopin, Brahms and Liszt
programme.desc: Acclaimed classical music talent scout Antonio Mormone (1930-2017) lives on as the name-giver of the Premio Internazionale Antonio Mormone (PIAM), awarded to the winner of the Italian music competition of the same name. The first edition of this competition, which was held in various venues in Milan from 2019 to 2021, was dedicated to the piano.

programme.title: Couperin's Premier Livre, Masterly Mix
programme.desc: We have François Couperin to thank for some of the most stunning pages found in 18th-century harpsichord literature. Numbering more than 220 solo pieces, his four collections contain much of Couperin’s finest work. We found four keyboard heroes, each of whom was free to browse through his or her favourite volume. Today Aurélien Delage tackles the encyclopedic first volume – the calling card of a musical all-rounder.

programme.title: Divas and Diamonds
programme.desc: Musicians of the Danish National Symphony Orchestra, the DR Big Band, and the Danish National Vocal Ensemble join forces under the baton of Klaus To¨nshoff in this dazzling concert featuring great songs from black and white cinema.

programme.title: Mahler - Symphony No. 4
programme.desc: Bernard Haitink conducts the Berlin Philharmonic in a rendition of Gustav Mahler’s Symphony No. 4 in the Schauspielhaus in Berlin, in 1992. Soloist is soprano Sylvia McNair. Mahler composed his Fourth Symphony in 1899 and 1900, and it premiered in Munich, in 1901. The work incorporates the song 'Das himmlische Leben' ('The Heavenly Life'), which Mahler had already composed in 1892.

programme.title: The Divan Orchestra from the Alhambra
programme.desc: Millions of television viewers in Germany, France, Portugal, Greece and Finland experienced live the moving open-air concert within the highly symbolic surrounding of the Alhambra in Granada. Music as a language of peace – this vision unifies the young musicians of the West-Eastern Divan Orchestra who come from Israel, Palestine, Syria, Jordan, Egypt and Europe.

programme.title: Monteverdi - Madrigals, Book I
programme.desc: Italian composer Claudio Monteverdi (1567-1643) composed nine books of madrigals in half a century, which helped transform the genre from the polyphonic, a cappella madrigals of the late Renaissance to the ‘concertato’ madrigals of the early Baroque, shifting the style’s focus to the ability of music to express emotions contained in a text.

programme.title: Documentary 2017
programme.desc: This short documentary follows the participants of the 11th International Franz Liszt Piano Competition, held in TivoliVredenburg, Utrecht, in 2017. The competition actively presents, develops, and promotes piano talents from around the world. In doing so, it has become one of the prominent gateways to the international professional classical music scene for young musicians.

programme.title: Beethoven - Piano Concerto No. 3 in C minor
programme.desc: Conductor Eduard Topchjan leads the Armenian National Philharmonic Orchestra in a performance of Ludwig van Beethoven’s Piano Concerto No. 3 in C minor, Op. 37. Russian-born pianist Maya Oganyan (*2005) makes her solo debut with the orchestra. Beethoven composed this concerto in 1800 and played the piano part himself at the piece’s premiere in 1803. Like two of his other major works –Symphony No. 5 and Piano Sonata No.

programme.title: Richard Strauss - A Hero's Life, Op. 40
programme.desc: Franz Welser-Möst leads the Cleveland Orchestra in a concert performing Richard Strauss' Ein Heldenleben, Op. 40. Violin soloist is David Radzynski. Recorded at Severance Hall in Cleveland in February 2023. Strauss, at the age of 34, sparked outrage when he cast himself as the central figure of his tone poem. Generally agreed to be autobiographical, the work contains more than thirty quotations from Strauss's earlier works.

programme.title: IVC 2019 - Final: Haydn, Schubert et al.
programme.desc: Mezzo-soprano Ema Nikolovska (Canada, 1993) and pianist Michael Sikich (United States, 1993) perform ‘The sailor’s song’ from Joseph Haydn’s Six original canzonettas, Book 2 – Hob. XXVIa; Franz Schubert’s Auf dem See, Op. 92 No. 2 (D. 543); ‘Botschaft’ from Johannes Brahms’s Fünf Lieder, Op. 47; ‘Röselein, Röselein!’ from Robert Schumann’s Sechs Gesänge, Op.

programme.title: Bach - Brandenburg Concertos
programme.desc: The Orchestra Mozart, founded in 2004, is supposed to give young, talented musicians a possibility to play in a world-class orchestra being conducted by one of the outstanding conductors of our time. Claudio Abbado, the artistic director, is responsible for its profile, inviting musicians and chamber ensembles of international reputation.

programme.title: A Mozart Celebration from Berlin
programme.desc: Performed in the grandeur of Berlin's foremost opera house, the Staatsoper Unter den Linden, the Mozart Celebration is dedicated to the life's work of Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart. This one-time-only gala concert features exuberant Mozart pieces, performed by some of the world’s leading singers and musicians. Conductor Julien Salemkour leads these beautiful performances played by the Staatskapelle Berlin.

programme.title: Symphony No. 5
programme.desc: Composed between 1901 and 1902, Mahler's Fifth Symphony marked a significant shift in his compositional style, moving away from vocal elements toward a purely symphonic structure. It's a work of immense scope and emotional depth, known for its rich orchestral textures and intricate counterpoint.

programme.title: In the Organ's Stomach
programme.desc: Olivier Latry is the current holder of the Great Organ of Notre Dame. Between its original religious function and the interest of composers of all times, the great organ Cavaillé-Coll reveals its absolute modernity. Latry is considered one of the greatest organists of his generation, both in France and internationally.

programme.title: Waldbühne 1993: Russian Night
programme.desc: Every year the Berliner Philharmoniker gives an outstanding concert at the Waldbühne. This amphitheatre in Berlin can host 22,000 people and is used for many events such as film showings, boxing matches and concerts. In 1993 the Berliner Philharmoniker, under the baton of the Japanese conductor Seiji Ozawa, performed a Russian program. The concert starts with Russian Easter Festival Overture, Op.

programme.title: Liszt - Aida (from Parafrasi da opere)
programme.desc: Daniel Barenboim performs Liszt's Aida (Parafrasi da opere di Guiseppe Verdi) at Milan's La Scala in 2007.

programme.title: Classica Spotlight
programme.desc: Cinematic classical clips and energizing concert pieces featuring up-and-coming artists.

programme.title: Mozart - Piano Concerto No. 27, KV 595
programme.desc: Soloist Aleksander Madzar and the Royal Philharmonic Orchestra directed by Andre Previn join forces in a performance of Mozart's Piano Concerto No. 27, KV 595, recorded at Vienna's Schönbrunn palace. In 1791, with his life cruelly and rapidly ending, Mozart once again turned to the compositional style which reflected his personality: the concerto for piano and orchestra.

programme.title: Mozart - Violin Concerto No. 3, K. 216
programme.desc: Every year, the Europakonzert is hosted by the Berliner Philharmoniker in a notorious concert hall or on a special location. This years concert is performed at the magnificent Royal Albert Hall in London. The Dutch conductor Bernard Haitink starts with Tchaikovsky's Fantasy Overture from 'Roméo et Juliette'. The second piece by Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart is his famous Violin Concerto No. 3 in G major K.

programme.title: Jaroussky sings Bach And Telemann
programme.desc: The film Jaroussky sings Bach And Telemann is a portrait of a very special vocalist, and of two exceptional composers. When Philippe Jaroussky - whose angelic voice seems almost timeless, not belonging to any one epoque or decade - sings works by Telemann and Bach, it becomes abundantly clear that the sheer emotional force and the purifying power of their music have not diminished over the centuries.

programme.title: Beethoven - String Quartet No. 2, Op. 18, No. 2
programme.desc: Renowned French string quartet Quatuor Ébène marked the 250th birth anniversary of Ludwig van Beethoven (1770-1827) with a remarkable project: recording all of the great composer’s sixteen string quartets. For five years, violinists Pierre Colombet and Gabriel Le Magadure, violist Marie Chilemme, and cellist Raphaël Merlin immersed themselves in Beethoven’s 650 pages of sheet music.

programme.title: The Boy with the Wig: Kids on Mozart
programme.desc: The Boy with the Wig - Kids on Mozart explores children’s fascination with the composer. The 30-minute film by Claus Wischmann features boys and girls aged between eight and eleven recounting his life through humour and serious interpretations of Mozart’s biography. Discover Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart through the eyes of children.

programme.title: Schumann - Symphonic Etudes, Op. 13
programme.desc: After recording all 32 Ludwig van Beethoven piano sonatas to celebrate the composer's 250th birth anniversary, celebrated Italian pianist Riccardo Schwartz decided to record solo piano works by Robert Schumann. In this performance, Schwartz presents Schumann’s Symphonic Etudes, Op. 13. Composed between 1834-37, the work began as a theme and a set of sixteen variations.

programme.title: Classica Spotlight
programme.desc: Cinematic classical clips and energizing concert pieces featuring up-and-coming artists.

programme.title: Beethoven - Symphony No. 9 in D minor, Op. 125
programme.desc: Swiss conductor Philippe Jordan and the Orchestre de l’Opéra national de Paris recorded all of Ludwig van Beethoven’s symphonies in 2014-2015. In this program, maestro Jordan presents Beethoven’s final symphony: Symphony No. 9 in D minor, Op. 125.

programme.title: The Red Priest and the Tanguero
programme.desc: The ensemble YES Camerata (Young European String Camerata) and violinist William Hagen perform The Red Priest and the Tanguero at the Academiezaal in the Belgian city of Sint-Truiden in 2017. The concert program includes The Four Seasons of Antonio Vivaldi (1679-1741) and Las quatros estaciones porteñas of Astór Piazzolla (1921-1992), in a transcription of Leonid Desyatnikov.

programme.title: In Rehearsal: Esa-Pekka Salonen
programme.desc: The Finnish composer and conductor Esa-Pekka Salonen (1958) was Music Director of the Los Angeles Philharmonic from 1992 until 2009. Under his dynamic leadership, it was recognized as one of the world's most outstanding orchestras. The exciting musical partnership Salonen established with his musicians was widely acclaimed in the international press.

programme.title: Bach - Sonata No. 6 BWV 1019
programme.desc: This Sonata for Violin and Harpsichord No.6 BWV 1019 is the last of the set of sonatas that Johann Sebastian Bach composed before 1725, probably while working as chapel master in Köthen. He presumably wrote these sonatas for Prince Leopold and later adapted them for further use in Leipzig.

programme.title: Bruch - Violin Concerto No. 1, Op. 26
programme.desc: Sir Simon Rattle conducts the Berliner Philharmonic during the 2008 edition of the Europakonzert, held in the renowned hall of the Tchaikovsky Conservatory in Moscow. The first edition of the Europakonzert was in 1991, and since then, the founding of the Berlin Philharmonic on May 1st in 1882 is annually celebrated with a concert in a European city of cultural significance.

programme.title: Bruges: The Burgundian Metropolis
programme.desc: By the 14th century, the Duchy of Burgundy had made Bruges its official residence. The city became a magnet for artists. The Gruuthuse manuscript, the oldest known collection of Middle Dutch songs, gives expression to the ebullient character of Bruges the metropolis. ClubMediéval juxtaposes these songs with works by Oswald von Wolkenstein and Machaut.

programme.title: Cello: Busoni, Liszt, Chopin And Rachmaninoff
programme.desc: Italian cellist Silvia Chiesa and Italian pianist Maurizio Baglini perform a wonderful recital of works by Ferruccio Busoni, Franz Liszt, Frédéric Chopin, and Sergei Rachmaninoff. On the program are Busoni’s Kultaselle – 10 variations on a Finnish folksong; Liszt’s Two Elegies for cello and piano; Chopin’s Introduction and Polonaise brillante in C major, Op. 3; and Rachmaninoff’s Sonata in G minor for cello and piano, Op. 19.

programme.title: Bruckner - Symphony No. 9
programme.desc: Anton Bruckner's Symphony No. 9 can be seen as a farewell to life. Even as Bruckner began working on it in 1887, his health had begun to fail. He expressed the hope that 'God will grant me enough time to complete it,' and worked on it assiduously over the next years. But by late 1894 he had completed only the first three movements. When he died on 11 October 1896, he left six different versions of the finale, all of them incomplete.

programme.title: Misha Fomin at the Concertgebouw
programme.desc: Since his spectacular debut recital at the Amsterdam Concertgebouw in 2002, pianist Misha Fomin has become an indispensable part of Dutch musical life. National and international press praise his playing for its fluently natural virtuosity, rich color palette, and great musical intelligence.

programme.title: Mozart - String Quartet No. 19 in C major, K. 465
programme.desc: Les Dissonances is a collective of artists founded by violinist David Grimal in 2004. The conductorless ensemble consists of musicians from the most prestigious European orchestras, international soloists, and young talents.

programme.title: Music of Naples
programme.desc: Throughout the centuries, the Italian city of Naples has proved to have a remarkably favorable climate for artistic innovation. The presence of the royal or vice royal courts, the practice of music in churches, fraternities, and charitable institutions, financial support from well-to-do citizens, and the popularity of song and dance in public life made for an extraordinarily diverse musical landscape.

programme.title: Beethoven - Symphony No. 4 in B-flat major, Op. 60
programme.desc: Swiss conductor Philippe Jordan and the Orchestre de l’Opéra national de Paris recorded all of Ludwig van Beethoven’s symphonies in 2014-2015. In this program, Jordan conducts Beethoven’s Symphony No. 4 in B-flat major, Op. 60. Count Franz von Oppersdorff adored Beethoven’s Symphony No. 2 and offered the composer a large sum to write a similar work. Beethoven obliged and completed his Symphony No. 4 in the autumn of 1806.

programme.title: Welser-Möst conducts Farrenc, Ravel And Mussorgsky
programme.desc: Franz Welser-Möst conducts the Cleveland Orchestra in a program recorded at Severance Music Center in Cleveland in March 2023. On the program are Louise Farrenc's Symphony No. 3, Ravel's Piano Concerto in G (featuring Vïkingur Ólafsson as soloist) and Mussorgsky's Pictures at an Exhibition (orchestration by Ravel).

programme.title: Brahms - Symphony No. 2 in D major, Op. 73
programme.desc: Les Dissonances is a collective of artists founded by violinist David Grimal in 2004. The conductorless ensemble consists of musicians from the most prestigious European orchestras, international soloists, and young talents. In this performance, Les Dissonances present Johannes Brahms’s Symphony No. 2 in D major, Op. 73. Whereas it took the composer over a decade to complete his first symphony, he penned his Symphony No.

programme.title: Shusha Renaissance (2023)
programme.desc: “Shusha, the Renaissance” is a musical journey featuring pianist Murad Huseynov. The city of Shusha is often considered the cradle of Azerbaijan's music and poetry and one of the leading centres of the Azerbaijani culture, having been declared the cultural capital of Azerbaijan in January 2021. On the program are the following works: Fikret Amirov’s (1922-1984) Twelve Miniatures for Piano Solo: I. Ballade - II. Ashigsayagi – III.

programme.title: Shostakovich - Violin Concerto No. 1, Op. 99
programme.desc: The Berliner Philharmoniker is one of the world’s finest orchestras, its fame stretching all the way to Japan. Unsurprisingly, this 2000 concert, recorded at Tokyo’s magnificent Suntory Hall, was a resounding success. Mariss Jansons conducts a beautiful program that includes Antonin Dvorák’s Symphony No. 8, Carl Maria von Weber’s Overture to Oberon, and Dmitri Shostakovich’s Violin Concerto featuring star violinist Hilary Hahn (*1979).

programme.title: Gala from Berlin 1998 - Songs of Love and Desire
programme.desc: Featuring W. A. Mozart and Giuseppe Verdi, love is the theme of this 1998 New Year's Eve concert. Maestro Claudio Abbado selected two of the best Mozart interpreters, Christine Schäfer and Simon Keenlyside, for this traditionally meaningful event.

programme.title: Israel Philharmonic Orchestra: Coming Home
programme.desc: On December 24, 2011, one of the world’s most renowned classical orchestras, the Israel Philharmonic Orchestra, celebrated the 75th anniversary of its founding. The film portrays the orchestra and its eventful history against the backdrop of Israel and the holocaust.

programme.title: Verdi - La traviata
programme.desc: This production of Giuseppe Verdi's popular opera La Traviata was performed outdoors at the St. Margarethen Festival in 2008 by the Slovak Philharmonic Orchestra under the direction of Ernst Märzendorfer. Soloists Kristiane Kaiser, Magdalena Anna Hofmann, and Stefanie Kopinits perform in a striking physical setting against the backdrop of the Austrian mountains.

programme.title: Liga D’ouro - Ep. 200
programme.desc: As emoções do futebol jogam se todos os dias. Todas as novidades dos grandes do futebol a caminho de mais uma jornada de golos, polémicas, alegrias e tristezas para Benfica, Sporting e Porto.

programme.title: Jornal Da Meia-noite
programme.desc: Cobertura intensiva da atualidade, em direto, com reportagem e análise da atualidade e dos exclusivos com a marca da CMTV.

programme.desc: Magazine de novas tecnologias, tendências, comportamentos e inovação que marca a sociedade portuguesa conduzido por Suely Costa.

programme.title: Língua Mãe T5 - Ep. 15
programme.desc: No ‘Língua Mãe’, Carlos Alberto Moniz sai em busca dos autores portugueses. Gente que escreve, compõe, pinta, encena, sempre no seu próprio mundo solitário, por vezes desconhecido de quem não vê TV, rádio, internet, exposições, passagens de modelos ou de quem não tem hábitos de leitura. De Macau a Timor, de Angola a São Tomé e Príncipe, de Cabo Verde a Moçambique, da Guiné ao Brasil, estes autores têm um denominador comum: a língua...

programme.title: Olá, Bom Dia!
programme.desc: Olá, Bom dia! é o programa de proximidade e afeto que lhe faz companhia todas as manhãs. Apresentado por Luciana Abreu e Rúben Pacheco Correia, traz alegria, humor, grandes convidados, bons conselhos, as notícias da vida dos famosos e música. Com a boa energia do Olá, Bom dia! o seu dia será melhor!

O sector dos pequenos frutos, tem demonstrado um notável dinamismo, e um crescente interesse por parte dos consumidores e uma importância crescente na agricultura portuguesa.

programme.title: Documentário: Telhados De Vidro - Leiria

programme.title: Intercidades
programme.desc: O Intercidades é a viagem regional de fim de tarde do Conta Lá, conduzida por Rita Ferro Rodrigues, em estúdio, e uma vasta equipa de repórteres sempre em movimento pelas regiões. O programa distingue-se pelo olhar atento ao país, ligando estúdio e território em tempo real. O comboio vai parar nos vários concelhos e levar-nos até quem faz cada localidade — do café à escola, do campo à praça.

programme.title: Ultraje: Traje De Festa De Lavradeira Abastada - Ilhavo
programme.desc: “Ultraje” é uma viagem vibrante pelo coração da identidade portuguesa. Em cada episódio, percorremos o país para descobrir os trajes típicos que contam histórias de outras gerações, mergulhando nas tradições, costumes e festas que lhes dão vida. Mais do que roupa, são símbolos de orgulho, resistência e pertença — preservados por homens e mulheres que mantêm viva a memória coletiva.

programme.title: Minha Terra Minha Gente
programme.desc: “Minha Terra, Minha Gente” apresenta o melhor dos 308 concelhos do território, através da tradição, da inovação e da sustentabilidade. São empolgantes histórias de vida que personificam o amor à terra. Memórias das pessoas e dos locais, para as gerações futuras, com testemunhos marcantes e inspiradores de gente apaixonada: usos, costumes e tradições do rico património de Portugal. .

programme.desc: Mike encontra um Isetta bubble car. Parte carro, parte mota, este clássico deve ser fantástico de conduzir, mas não é muito divertido para reparar! Dará algum lucro?

programme.title: Joias Sobre Rodas T14 - Ep. 1
programme.desc: O negociante de automóveis Mike Brewer e o multi-talentoso mecânica Ant Anstead têm como missão encontrar e restaurar carros clássicos para vender mais tarde na sua garagem de LA.

programme.desc: Desesperado para gerir mais minas de ouro, Todd liga o tambor giratório de limpeza de minério, mas a estação está tão usada que lhe chama «Hot Mess».

programme.title: Hoffman Family Gold T1 - Ep. 4
programme.desc: É o aniversário de Jack, mas os objetivos da temporada não deixam tempo para o bolo. A equipa deve saber o motivo do derrame de mais de metade de ouro na mina pelo Hot Mess.

programme.desc: Descubra como as cápsulas de CO2, roscas doces, gruas em tesoura e ringues de skate são criados, enquanto mais objetos do quotidiano são vistos ao microscópio.

programme.desc: À medida que objetos do quotidiano são vistos ao microscópio, descubra como as motos, cachimbos de barro, bastões de bateria e apitos são feitos.

programme.desc: Saiba como as algemas, a calafetagem e bilhas de gás propano são criadas, enquanto mais objetos do quotidiano são vistos ao microscópio.

programme.title: O Jogo do Destino - Ep. 99
programme.desc: Bahar abre um curso profissional num bairro pobre para ajudar as donas de casa, e aí conhece Demir. O conflito entre ambos começa com uma confusão ao comprar uma sobremesa e num acidente de mota. Apesar da tensão, forma-se um laço. Quando Bahar fica presa num incêndio, Demir arrisca a própria vida para a salvar. Entretanto, Aysun planeia vingar-se de Harun, planeando casar com ele, matá-lo e começar uma nova vida com Demir.

programme.title: Ressurreição: Ertugru T2 - Ep. 61
programme.desc: Na segunda temporada, a tribo Kayi alia-se aos clãs turcomanos para resistir à invasão mongol. Ertugrul é capturado e torturado, mas escapa e regressa para enfrentar a traição, o exílio e planos maquiavélicos. Expõe conspirações, resgata o seu filho, derrota Noyan e leva o seu povo para oeste para fundar um novo estado.

programme.title: Nova Oportunidade T1 - Ep. 46
programme.desc: NOVA OPORTUNIDADE é uma nova série dramática ambiciosa e de grande sucesso, com algumas das maiores estrelas da Turquia. A história centra-se em Deniz, uma mulher inocente que tem tudo o que poderia desejar na vida, até que o marido desaparece sem deixar rasto. Após perder tudo o que possuía, vê-se numa situação desesperada e enfrenta uma luta diária pela sobrevivência, necessitando de lutar pelo bem dos seus filhos e do seu pai idoso.

programme.title: O Círculo - Ep. 7
programme.desc: Dois jovens, Cihangir e Kaan, são atraídos para um jogo mortal gerido por uma organização criminosa chamada O Círculo. Trocados à nascença por líderes da máfia, crescem sem conhecer as suas verdadeiras identidades. Anos mais tarde, os seus caminhos voltam a cruzar-se enquanto lutam pela justiça e pelo amor, enredados numa teia de segredos, traição e poder.

Após perder tudo o que possuía, vê-se numa situação desesperada e enfrenta uma luta diária pela sobrevivência, necessitando de lutar pelo bem dos seus filhos e do seu pai idoso.

programme.title: O Jogo do Destino - Ep. 103

programme.title: Jazzed Out Tokyo
programme.desc: Jazzed Out proves that a jazz session can take place anywhere. Unusual locations, such as garage buildings, multi-storey car parks, street corners, subway trains, and parks, in several of the world’s metropoles, provide the setting for brief jazz performances. The sheer rawness of the metropoles merge with the musical creations of various artists in search of the perfect ‘urban stage’.

programme.title: Portrait of Roy Ayers
programme.desc: ‘The legend of the groove’ is a series of documentaries devoted to the musicians who were most influential on contemporary hip hop, soul, rhythm 'n' blues, and on the course of history. Between the late 1950s and now, these musicians radically changed music. Although sometimes hardly in the public eye, they have all been major sources of inspiration for today's major artists: Prince, Erykah Badu, Janis Joplin and Jimi Hendrix.

programme.title: Kurhaus Scheveningen: Beets And Rosenwinkel
programme.desc: The Dutch world-class jazz pianist Peter Beets has shared the stage with jazz greats like Chick Corea, Wynton Marsalis, “Toots” Thielemans, Elvin Jones, George Coleman, Johnny Griffin, Benny Golson and John Clayton. From birth, Beets was surrounded by music: he heard classical music from his mother, who is a music pedagogue, and he heard jazz from his father, who has a great fan of Oscar Peterson and Art Blakey.

programme.title: Belgium Sessions: Ben Sluijs
programme.desc: In this DJAZZ Belgium Sessions performance, which was recorded at AED Studios in Lint, Belgium, we witness Europe’s finest jazz musicians at work. A wide variety of international jazz musicians give a creative, up-close and inside insight into their art of playing jazz music. Young talent and established jazz musicians play to their heart’s content. Saxophonist Ben Sluijs received a classical training.

programme.title: Malta Jazz Festival
programme.desc: On July 20, 2018, double bassist Christian McBride presented his band ‘New Jawn’ at the Malta Jazz Festival. A five-time Grammy winner, McBride is one of the most requested, most recorded, and most respected figures in the music world today. Hailing from Philadelphia, this music luminary combines jazz, RAndB, pop/rock, hip hop/neo-soul, and classical.

programme.title: Brazilian NYE
programme.desc: The Da Pá Virada Sessions series presents the best musicians of contemporary Brazilian jazz, and beyond. Filmed in São Paulo, each session offers a unique experience by giving a fresh look into Brazil's music scene. The artists for each session are selected in consultation with Stingray DJAZZ's music editor.

programme.title: DJAZZ Clips
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: Artillerie Lourde
programme.desc: To celebrate the release of Django, the Parisian New Morning Club pays tribute to the legendary guitarist Django Reinhardt. The program showcases the magic of Reinhardt’s compositions, as well as the virtuosity of one of his most famous heirs: Stochelo Rosenberg. With unbridled passion and enthusiasm, Rosenberg interprets the music that marked French musical heritage: gypsy jazz.

programme.title: Terrasson And Belmondo: À Nous Garo
programme.desc: Every year, the Jazz en Baie festival takes place in the beautiful bay of Mont Saint-Michel Today’s broadcast shows a special gathering between two grandmasters of French jazz: pianist Jacky Terrasson and trumpeter Stéphane Belmondo. The two team up for an amazing concert in which jazz is combined with soul and a touch of chanson française.

programme.title: Saluzzi, Mariano And Dauner live in Stuttgart
programme.desc: Dino Saluzzi, one of Argentina's tango music masters, has been building his legacy since the mid-1980s. His accordion-like bandoneon defines Argentina's tango music. Saluzzi has explored many paths—paths along which he has rarely travelled more than once, despite some common threads.

programme.title: Paradox Live: Bertus Borgers And The Young Retro's
programme.desc: Innovative contemporary jazz and improvised music, the search for modernity, mind blowing sounds, rock and pop… Indeed PARADOX Tilburg goes beyond jazz, crossing musical boundaries into the unknown soundscapes of electronic music. Indie artists, blues veterans and jazz superstars all pour their hearts and souls at the Paradox.

programme.title: DJAZZ Clips
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: DJAZZ Portrait: Jazzdag
programme.desc: These portraits of artists, concerts and festivals give a good impression of the jazz world. Both famous and less famous jazz artists will give a new insight in their life. DJAZZ asked them why they wrote that special song, what was the first record they bought and what is his or her most precious musical memory. The festival portraits are beautiful reports filmed at the most special jazz festivals and concerts.

programme.title: São Paulo Samba
programme.desc: An exceptional concert from Brazil: the Orquestra Sinfônica do Estado de São Paulo proves its position as the most important orchestra in Latin America. Conducted by charismatic Maestro John Neschling since 1997, the orchestra is defined by its emblematic interpretations of Latin American music.

programme.title: North Sea Jazz Archive: Wayne Shorter Quartet
programme.desc: The world-renowned North Sea Jazz Festival features a wide variety of genres, including traditional New Orleans jazz, swing, bop, free jazz, fusion, avant-garde and electronic jazz, blues, gospel, funk, soul, RAndB, hip hop, world beat and Latin. The festival was founded by entrepreneur and jazz fan Paul Acket, who sold his highly successful pop magazine publishing house to organize and fund the first edition of the festival in 1976.

programme.title: Salif Keita And Les Ambassadeurs
programme.desc: Salif Keita’s music is a rich combination of traditional Malian music with European and American influences. We can hear this in the instrumentation of Keita’s music, which varies from traditional West-African instruments to Western European ones. The Malian singer was cast out by his family because of his albinism. In 1967 he moved to Bamako, where he started his musical career and joined Les Ambassadeurs (Internationaux).

programme.title: DJAZZ Clips
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: Qui nem gilo
programme.desc: Brazilian artist Gilberto Gil returns to Jazz à Vienne in France with a new round of singing that is inspired by his latest album ‘Fé na Festa’: a mixture of celebration, tradition and even some rock now and then. Gilberto Gil, worldwide known for as musician and the Brazilian minister of Culture, was one of the pioneers of the cultural movement ‘tropicalismo’.

programme.title: Art Blakey And The Jazz Messengers - Olympia, Paris
programme.desc: The legendary hard-bop group Art Blakey's Jazz Messengers performed in Olympia Hall in Paris, France on March 16, 1963. Led by drummer Art Blakey, the Jazz Messengers consisted of Wayne Shorter on tenor saxophone, Freddie Hubbard on trumpet, Curtis Fuller on trombone, Reggie Workman on double bass, and Cedar Walton on piano. Each of these players became jazz legends in their own right.

programme.title: Tribute to Elis Regina - Da Pá Virada Sessions
programme.desc: The Da Pá Virada Sessions series presents the best musicians of contemporary Brazilian jazz, and beyond. Filmed in São Paulo, each session offers a unique experience by giving a fresh look into Brazil's music scene. The artists for each session are selected in consultation with Stingray DJAZZ's music editor.

programme.title: NSJC: Busstra's Old School Band
programme.desc: Guitarist, composer and director Marnix Busstra loves crossing borders. He travels the world with his jazz bands, plays guitar and bouzouki, writes jazz and theatre-songs, and co-creates and directs the exuberant theatre shows of his wife, the Dutch diva Karin Bloemen. Busstra is a constant wheel of invention, with technique expanded by his creative urge to find something new, an evolving state that adds immeasurably to his art.

programme.title: PC Qwintett: 75th year of Courbois
programme.desc: Pierre Courbois has been one of Europe’s leading jazz musicians since the mid-sixties. This concert, recorded at the renowned Amsterdam jazz club Bimhuis, sees the drummer playing with his QWINTETT. On the occasion of his 75th birthday in 2015, Courbois hit the road for the Pierre Courbois 75 Years Anniversary Tour.

programme.title: The Hammond© Sessions: Rob Mostert Hammond Group
programme.desc: The Dutch Hammond organ player Rob Mostert develops, in cooperation with DJAZZ, the programme ‘Mostert Meets’. In this series, the Hammond B3 organ takes centre stage. Rob Mostert invites the world’s finest jazz musicians for a musical collaboration, in which the Hammond Organ plays a major role.

programme.title: Earl Hines Quartet in Spa, 1977
programme.desc: Despite his advanced age, the legendary jazz pianist Earl Hines was at the top of his game when he performed in the Belgian town of Spa in 1977. With a band consisting of Rudy Rutherford (reeds), Jimmy Leary (bass), and Eddie Graham (drums), Hines livens up the room with his interpretations of “I Can’t Believe That You’re In Love With Me” and “The Man I Love.

programme.title: DJAZZ Clips
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: TorTube: Tingvall Trio - Vägen
programme.desc: Jazz fans in television land have come to the right place for their dose of first-rate world jazz: TorTube! Jazz club De Tor in Enschede is one of Europe’s most authentic jazz venues, with an absolutely unique ambiance. Some of the best musicians from Holland and the rest of the world find their way to De Tor to perform for an appreciative audience of jazz fans.

programme.title: DJAZZ Portrait: Jarrod Lawson
programme.desc: These portraits of artists, concerts and festivals give a good impression of the jazz world. Both famous and less famous jazz artists will give a new insight in their life. DJAZZ asked them why they wrote that special song, what was the first record they bought and what is his or her most precious musical memory. The festival portraits are beautiful reports filmed at the most special jazz festivals and concerts.

programme.title: Mr Gentle and Mr Cool
programme.desc: The Royal Concertgebouw in Amsterdam is a world-renowned concert hall, known for its first-rate acoustics. It has attracted many famous performers over the years and is one of the Netherlands' most treasured musical institutions. On November 2, 1958, American jazz titan Duke Ellington and his Orchestra performed two concerts at the Concertgebouw in Amsterdam.

programme.title: Etienne Mbappe - Jazzwoche Burghausen
programme.desc: Every year since 1970, the German city of Burghausen has been hosting one of the largest jazz festivals in the world. During Burghausen International Jazz Week, Burghausen becomes a 'Bavarian jazz mecca': guests from all over the world join the Burghausers to enjoy the most wonderful jazz performances as the colorful hustle and bustle of spectators and musicians shake up the city.

programme.title: Live at Paradiso, Amsterdam
programme.desc: Does a crisis stimulate creativity? When COVID-19 prevented the Robert Jay Band from performing for live audiences in 2021, the idea for ‘Paradiso Sessions’ sprang forth. Funk, rock, and soul guitarist, vocalist and songwriter Robert J. Reinders mused, “if our audience will not come to see us, then we must go to see them”. Hence the Robert Jay Band settled down in an atmospheric Paradiso in Amsterdam to perform for nine cameras.

programme.title: DJAZZ Portrait: Saxophone Greats
programme.desc: These portraits of artists, concerts and festivals give a good impression of the jazz world. Both famous and less famous jazz artists will give a new insight in their life. DJAZZ asked them why they wrote that special song, what was the first record they bought and what is his or her most precious musical memory. The festival portraits are beautiful reports filmed at the most special jazz festivals and concerts.

programme.title: DJAZZ Clips
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: Trio Chemirani: Dawâr
programme.desc: The veritable tombak virtuosos of Trio Chemirani, consisting of Chemirani Senior and Juniors, enrapture the Festival de Saintes. The tombak is a Persian percussion instrument, but its rhythms are universal. The Trio Chemirani’s music is accessible to all and will certainly resound with each listener. The members of the trio, Djamchid Chemirani (born in Teheran in 1942) and his two sons and pupils Keyvan and Bijan, are living in France.

programme.title: Kurt Rosenwinkel meets Peter Beets Trio
programme.desc: The Dutch world-class jazz pianist Peter Beets has shared the stage with jazz greats like Chick Corea, Wynton Marsalis, “Toots” Thielemans, Elvin Jones, George Coleman, Johnny Griffin, Benny Golson and John Clayton. From birth, Beets was surrounded by music: he heard classical music from his mother, who is a music pedagogue, and he heard jazz from his father, who has a great fan of Oscar Peterson and Art Blakey.

programme.title: Anita Oday Live in Sweden 1963
programme.desc: Anita O’Day?boasts two wonderful concerts from 1963 and 1970 that present the “jazz singer supreme” in impeccable form. O’Day’s horn-based approach to singing is in full effect throughout both shows including stand-out renditions in each show of audience favorites “Tea For Two” and “Sweet Georgia Brown” (both reprised from her triumphant appearance at the 1958 Newport Jazz Festival.

programme.title: Sven Hammond: 10th Year Anniversary Concert
programme.desc: The band Sven Hammond used to be known as Sven Hammond Soul. But the members have remained the same, with Ivan Peroti (vocals), Sven Figee (hammond/keys), Tim Eijmaal (guitar), Glenn Gaddum Jr. (bass) and Joost Kroon (drums). Sven Hammond creates greasy funk and soul, featuring hammond grooves, pop and jazz. This steaming music and show machine is headed by Sven Figee, who prefers to attack rather than play his Hammond organ.

programme.title: Sly Johnson And Nicholas V. - Tribute to Marvin Gaye
programme.desc: For 20 years, Sly Johnson, author, composer and performer of the Saïan Supa Crew, has been touring the French music scene with his soul, hip-hop and beat-box vocals. He leaves his machines in the studio for a tribute concert to one of the leading voices of the famous Motown label, Marvin Gaye. The singer was killed by his father, a pastor, the day before his 45th birthday.

programme.title: DJAZZ Clips
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: Count Basie and his Orchestra live in Charleroi
programme.desc: Count Basie is one of the most important bandleaders of the swing era. With the exception of a brief period in the early '50s, he led a big band from 1935 until his death almost 50 years later. Basie's orchestra was characterized by a light, swinging rhythm section that he led from the piano, lively ensemble work, and generous soloing. Basie was not a composer like Duke Ellington or an important soloist like Benny Goodman.

programme.title: Thomas Carbou: Spectacle Au Bleury
programme.desc: Thomas Carbou and Patrick Graham share an almost telepathic rapport, blending spontaneous improvisation, electronic looping, and Brazilian and Indian musical influences to create ecstatic groove pieces and dream-like soundscapes.

programme.title: Blicher Hemmer Gadd - A Music documentary
programme.desc: Award-winning saxophonist Michael Blicher, Hammond wizard Dan Hemmer and legendary drummer Steve Gadd joined forces in 2014 to celebrate their shared love for Hammond-organ soul jazz. The band, which tours extensively throughout the world, has released several albums. Their third album, which was released in November 2019, features U.K. vocalist Paul Carrack on the soulful ballad 'The First One To Know'.

programme.title: DJAZZ Clips
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: B.B. King: The King of the Blues in Stuttgart
programme.desc: This uptempo, funky performance proves that B.B. King, one of the Masters of the Blues Guitar has still got it. The band features some of today's best blues musicians playing all of B.B. King's classic songs.

programme.title: The Morgenland Festival: I Will Not Be Sad
programme.desc: Since 2005, the Morgenland Festival, held in Osnabrueck, has dedicated itself to the fascinating music culture of the Near and Middle East. From traditional and classical music to avant-garde, jazz, and rock, the festival program also features art, such as visual arts, dance, and theatre of interdisciplinary projects. Jivan Gasparyan Jr has always been inspired by the folk melodies of his native Armenia.

programme.title: Jazzed Out Swiss
programme.desc: Jazzed Out proves that a jazz session can take place anywhere. Unusual locations, such as garage buildings, multi-storey car parks, street corners, subway trains, and parks, in several of the world’s metropoles, provide the setting for brief jazz performances. The sheer rawness of the metropoles merge with the musical creations of various artists in search of the perfect ‘urban stage’.

programme.title: How Deep Is The Ocean
programme.desc: Two top-tier Belgian musicians – guitarist Philip Catherine and bassist Jean-Louis Rassinfosse – accompany American jazz trumpeter and vocalist Chet Baker during this 1985 performance at the beautiful Brussels Jazz Club, located on the Grand-Place, the Belgian capital’s central square. The trio plays Charlie Mariano’s “Crystal Bells”, the title track of their acclaimed 1983 album.

programme.title: View From The Outside
programme.desc: 'Münchner Klaviersommer' was an annual concerts series that took place from 1981 to 1998 in Munich, Germany. Although the festival's name suggests a strong focus on piano music, it featured countless famous musicians from jazz and classical music – not just pianists. The concerts were usually held in July at The Gasteig, home of the Munich Philharmonic.

programme.title: Benny Goodman Septet - North Sea Jazz Part II
programme.desc: The North Sea Jazz Festival is the largest indoor music festival in the world, known globally as the event where the past, present and future of jazz are featured within three days. Next to a firm base of jazz as the festival’s staple music genre, many others, such as blues, soul, funk, or hip hop, pass by.

programme.title: Buddy Rich Big Band - The North Sea Jazz
programme.desc: The North Sea Jazz Festival is the largest indoor music festival in the world, known globally as the event where the past, present and future of jazz are featured within three days. Next to a firm base of jazz as the festival’s staple music genre, many others, such as blues, soul, funk, or hip hop, pass by.

programme.title: Hypnotic Brass Ensemble - Jazzwoche Burghausen
programme.desc: Every year since 1970, the German city of Burghausen has been hosting one of the largest jazz festivals in the world. During Burghausen International Jazz Week, Burghausen becomes a 'Bavarian jazz mecca': guests from all over the world join the Burghausers to enjoy the most wonderful jazz performances as the colorful hustle and bustle of spectators and musicians shake up the city.

programme.title: MotorMusic Jazz Sessions: WRaP!
programme.desc: The MotorMusic Studios in Mechelen, Belgium, attract many great musicians to the city. A wide variety of visiting international jazz musicians share their art of making jazz music with us in the DJAZZ series ‘Belgium Sessions’. In these sessions, some of Europe’s finest musicians perform their own, original music. This episode MotorMusic invites the jazz trio ‘WRaP!

programme.title: Tivoli Utrecht: Sven Hammond Soul
programme.desc: Although its music might sound like the sound track of any 1970s American car chase movie, the band Sven Hammond Soul is from the Netherlands. This steaming soul machine is headed by Sven Figee, who prefers to attack rather than play his Hammond organ. In April 2012, the band was augmented with vocalist Jenny Lane. Today’s recordings were made at a steaming live performance at Utrecht’s Tivoli in 2012.

programme.title: Stingray PausePlay: Natalia M. King
programme.desc: We Pause and chat with local and international artists to get an in-depth look at their lives and music, they Play some amazing music in these, one-of-a-kind, live sessions! These portraits of artists, concerts and festivals give a good impression of the jazz world. Both famous and less famous jazz artists will give a new insight in their life.

programme.title: DJAZZ Clips
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: The Morgenland Festival: The Art of Duo
programme.desc: Since 2005, the Morgenland Festival of Osnabrueck has dedicated itself to the fascinating music culture of the Near and Middle East. From traditional and classical music to avant-garde, jazz, and rock, the festival program also features art, such as visual arts, dance, and theatre of interdisciplinary projects.

programme.title: Vocal Acrobats: Passion of an Improvised Journey
programme.desc: One vocalist from Paris and the other from Bern, and two contrasting personalities. Brought together by a chance encounter in 2014, the two singers were surprised to discover how much they had in common: they both do more than just sing well. Leïla Martial and Andreas Schaerer intend to explore and experiment, stretching their vocal boundaries.

programme.title: Chamber music: Sissoko And Segal
programme.desc: Hailing from a long tradition of Malian kora players, Ballake Sissoko has worked with renowned musicians such as Toumani Diabaté and Taj Mahal. He met the French born Vincent Ségal by chance, and the two began jamming together, uncertain of what kind of music might result.

programme.title: John Lee Hooker Live in Paris
programme.desc: In this 1970 performance at Maison de la Radio in Paris, France, American blues legend John Lee Hooker (voice and guitar) is joined by the masterful Carey Bell (harmonica), Joe Harper (bass), Lester Dorsie (drums), and Jimmy Dawkins (electric guitar).

programme.title: DJAZZ Clips
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: Vishten - WOMEX 2018
programme.desc: Since 1994, World Music Expo (WOMEX) has been attracting musicians, agents, a great number of press agencies, as well as media companies from all over the world. Its main exposition event has been held in various locations throughout Europe, including Berlin, Brussels, Marseille, Stockholm, Seville, Cardiff, and Budapest. The 2018 edition of WOMEX was held in Las Palmas, Gran Canaria.

programme.title: Final Step Live @ Il Magazzino: Three Sails
programme.desc: From the polyglot border region of Ticino in Switzerland – well-known for its beautiful Lake Maggiore and the International Film Festival in Locarno – comes ‘Final Step’, guitarist Matteo Finali’s seven-piece band. 'Live @ Il Magazzino' is the band’s third album since its formation in 2003. The diverse musical backgrounds of the various band members shine through on the album: it is a fusion of jazz, rock, funk, blues and ethnic music.

programme.title: Jazz a la Grand Place Chet Baker Trio
programme.desc: Two top-tier Belgian musicians – guitarist Philip Catherine and bassist Jean-Louis Rassinfosse – accompany American jazz trumpeter and vocalist Chet Baker during this 1985 performance at the beautiful Brussels Jazz Club, located on the Grand-Place, the Belgian capital’s central square. The trio plays Charlie Mariano’s “Crystal Bells”, the title track of their acclaimed 1983 album.

programme.title: Paradox Live: Philippe Lemm Trio
programme.desc: Innovative contemporary jazz and improvised music, the search for modernity, mind blowing sounds, rock and pop… Indeed PARADOX Tilburg goes beyond jazz, crossing musical boundaries into the unknown soundscapes of electronic music. Indie artists, blues veterans and jazz superstars all pour their hearts and souls at the Paradox.

programme.title: Trevor Richards
programme.desc: English drummer Trevor Richards (1945) is a passionate advocate for traditional jazz. After moving to New Orleans at 21 to master the city's unique drumming styles, he has consistently created opportunities to perform with the genre's elder statesmen.

programme.title: WCCB: Tina Rupprecht vs. Sumire Yamanaka T2025 - Ep. 405
programme.desc: From the MBS Arena in Potsdam, Germany, two World Champions meet to unify the titles when WBC and WBO Atomweight Champion Tina Rupprecht takes on undefeated IBF titleholder Sumire Yamanaka of Japan. Rupprecht, looking to add the IBF title to her collection, has held the WBC title for over six years, and added the WBO version in November by defeating Eri Matsuda.

programme.title: WCK T2 - Ep. 8
programme.desc: Experience the intensity of World Championship Kickboxing with the WCK Muay Thai Rules series, bringing elite international fighters into the spotlight for non-stop action. From explosive knockouts and technical battles to the electrifying atmosphere that has made Muay Thai one of the fastest-growing combat sports in the world, every bout delivers the excitement of world-class kickboxing.

programme.title: KNOCKOUTS! T1 - Ep. 5
programme.desc: The main event in this episode is Floyd Mayweather's return to boxing after a 21-month retirement. He takes on Juan Manuel Marquez in a fight that saw 1 million pay-per-view buys for a revenue of $52 million. Also on the card, action from a young Sergey Kovalev.

programme.title: FS Grand Sumo T31 - Ep. 3
programme.desc: For the first time the top ranked sumo competitors in the world are featured in an action packed series, FIGHT SPORTS GRAND SUMO. This new format presents Sumo in an authentic, in-depth and entertaining way covering the rules, ranks, match-ups, and more. Episode 3, from Ryogoku Kokugikan in Tokyo, Japan, features Kiribayama, Takakeisho, Shodai and Endo.

programme.title: American Ninja Warrior T7 - Ep. 16
programme.desc: In the Season 7 finale, contestants tackle the final three stages of the Mount Midoriyama course in Las Vegas. Stage 2 features a new obstacle, Roulette Row; and Stage 3 has the new Psycho Chain and Area 51 obstacles.

programme.title: FIGHT SPORTS MMA T1 - Ep. 149
programme.desc: This episode features main event Andrew 'One Gear' Van Zyl vs. Champion Dalcha for the heavyweight title. From EFC71 in Carnival City, Johannesburg, South Africa on 23-June-2018.

programme.title: MEGA Fights In 60 T1 - Ep. 9
programme.desc: MEGA Fights are premiere events from the sport of boxing including HBO World Championship Boxing and historic PPV events plus past, current and future World Champions. This episode features Light Heavyweight 'Bad' Chad Dawson (27-0, 17 KOs) vs. Antonio 'Magic Man' Tarver (27-5, 19 KOs).

programme.title: Greatest Classics T1 - Ep. 1
programme.desc: FIGHT SPORTS presents another exciting Greatest Classics episode, bringing you more action featuring the greatest fighters in boxing history. Twenty fights into his professional career, highly touted Olympic Gold Medalist Lennox Lewis was taking the steps towards claiming his first World Championship. He had knocked out nearly all of his opponents to this point, and a showdown with nemesis 'Razor' Ruddock was just a few months away.

programme.title: KNOCKOUTS! T1 - Ep. 14
programme.desc: The main event in this episode is Canelo Alvarez taking on Kermit Cintron in a bout that helped elevate Alvarez into the light middleweight title picture and take another step towards becoming one of the biggest names in boxing. Also on the card, action from a classic battle between Joel Casamayor and Michael Katsidis for the WBO Lightweight title.

programme.title: FS Grand Sumo T31 - Ep. 4
programme.desc: For the first time the top ranked sumo competitors in the world are featured in an action packed series, FIGHT SPORTS GRAND SUMO. This new format presents Sumo in an authentic, in-depth and entertaining way covering the rules, ranks, match-ups, and more. Episode 4, from Ryogoku Kokugikan in Tokyo, Japan, features Shodai, Mitakeumi, Kotoeko and Ichinojo.

programme.title: Macho: The Hector Camacho Story T1 - Ep. 2
programme.desc: This series takes a hard-hitting look at the rise, fall and untimely death of one of boxing's most colorful champions. Hector Camacho's dynamic speed, footwork and power made him a fighter to be reckoned with, but it was his flamboyance and showmanship that ushered in a new era in boxing.

programme.title: Tuesday Night Fights T1995 - Ep. 228
programme.desc: FIGHT SPORTS revisits some of Hector Camacho's best fights from the legendary USA's Tuesday Night Fights series alongside our new documentary series Macho: The Hector Camacho Story. In this episode Hector 'Macho' Camacho (48-3 22 KO 150 lbs) looks to continue his winning streak against Luis Maysonet (28-5 28 KO) in a 10-round contest from Foxwoods Resort Mashantucket CT USA.

programme.title: FS MMA T4 - Ep. 4
programme.desc: BodogFIGHT features classic MMA matches involving some of your favorite fighters! Former UFC veteran Francis Carmont squares off against Todd Broadway in Costa Rica.

programme.title: Code Rouge
programme.desc: Après avoir assisté à un colloque médical à Pékin, le docteur britannique Matthew Nolan échappe de peu à une agression dans une boîte de nuit. Il décide de rentrer à Londres mais à son arrivée à l’aéroport d’Heathrow, il est arrêté par la police pour meurtre. Il doit reprendre immédiatement l’avion pour la Chine escorté par l’agent de police britannique Hana Li. Parmi les passagers, trois de ses collègues chercheurs ont également été...

programme.title: Code Rouge
programme.desc: Des événements mystérieux se produisent à bord du vol 357. Hana Li mène l'enquête et découvre des indices troublants. Elle entre en contact avec la directrice du MI-5, Madeline Delanay, qui lui demande de la tenir au courant de ses découvertes. De son côté, Jess Li, la sœur journaliste d'Hana, poursuit ses propres investigations sur l'affaire du docteur Nolan.

programme.title: Enquêtes au Paradis
programme.desc: Le grand jour est arrivé. C'est le mariage de Glenn et Daisy. La cérémonie vient à peine de commencer quand une femme s'effondre et meurt en prononçant le prénom de Mack. Les noces attendront que le mystère soit éclairci. La victime, qui ne comptait pas parmi les invités, s'avère être une enquêtrice de la police à la retraite obnubilée par une vieille affaire.

programme.title: Meurtres au Paradis
programme.desc: Après son pot de départ, Neville, qui est nerveux à l'idée de prendre l'avion, prend des antihistaminiques et s'endort au décollage. À son réveil en Dominique, un des passagers a disparu. Mais Neville est le seul à noter son absence. Les trois autres personnes présentes dans l'avion affirment qu'il n'est jamais monté à bord. L'Inspecteur appelle Selwyn pour lui signaler la disparition et celui-ci lui apprend que le disparu, un dénommé...

programme.title: Les Rescapés de l'arianna
programme.desc: En mer, les survivants aperçoivent au loin un bateau qui leur redonne l’espoir d’être enfin sauvés. Malheureusement, cette rencontre tourne vite au cauchemar. A terre, Sylvie, à la fois terrifiée et en colère après Luca, emmène leurs filles en France, chez ses parents. Luca et les autres survivants se réunissent et décident de ne prendre aucun risque, puisque quelqu'un semble vouloir attenter à leur vie.

programme.title: Les Rescapés de l'arianna
programme.desc: En mer, les rescapés doivent faire face aux conséquences de leur dernière mésaventure. A terre, les liens et la confiance entre les derniers survivants s’effritent un peu plus, à mesure que l’enquête de la police avance.
